item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
Past Due 1.0.0

First release of Past Due, a community-maintained continuation of Max Langer's Latest.

  • Incorporates upstream 0.12-beta privileged background installer helper for Mac App Store updates on macOS 15.7+ and macOS 26+
  • Direct in-app Homebrew Cask updates via brew upgrade --cask
  • Improved Homebrew Cask bundle-ID matching and false-positive prevention
  • Fixes for launch crashes, NSTableView row reuse crashes, DisplayLink sleep/wake crashes, and recursive FSEvents folder monitoring
